name: customer-stories
title: Customer stories
description: Scrollable customer story cards with drag, arrow, and pagination controls.
usage: Case studies on the home and customers pages, and in a grid on the customers listing (the card alone). `tone` sets the controls for a white or a dark section; `showRules` draws the dotted rules above and below the row.
avoid: More than one call to action per card

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
